turns.user: Which published cement pastes have a plastic viscosity of 20 Pa.s or less together with a mini-slump flow diameter of at least 180 mm?
turns.text:
I’ll check the literature database for cement pastes with both reported properties meeting your limits.
The search found qualifying published mixes. The broader database check timed out; I’m simplifying that query. Some mixes have measurements at different elapsed times, so a match by mix name alone does not establish that both limits were met simultaneously.
**Published examples meeting both limits** in the literature database include the following. Values are extracted measurements, not model predictions.

| Published mix | Binder description | w/b | Plastic viscosity (Pa·s) | Mini-slump diameter (mm) | Source |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| No.1 | Portland cement | 0.30 | 1.16 | 260 | [Rheological behavior of CSA cement pastes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118234) |
| No.10 | CSA cement with silica fume | 0.24 | 2.97 | 245 | [Same study](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118234) |
| REF, w/b=0.35 | Portland cement–limestone powder | 0.35 | 0.57 | 330 | [Nanoclays in SCC pastes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118285) |
| PCPA00 | Portland cement with PCE | 0.29 | 1.19 | 250 | [PCE and APAM in cement paste](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cscm.2024.e03895) |
| OPC0.3 | Portland cement | 0.30 | 1.16 | 260 | [SCMs and water/binder ratios in CSA pastes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.powtec.2021.04.027) |
| M1 | Portland cement–fly ash | 0.30 | 1.14 | 268 | [Nano-silica modified cement-based materials](https://doi.org/10.3389/fmats.2021.712551) |

These are representative matches. The broader search also returned alkali-activated and hydraulic-lime pastes, which are excluded from this cement-paste shortlist.

**Qualification:** the database matches both properties to the same mix; it does not necessarily establish identical elapsed time or conditioning for the two tests. Check the original protocols before using a mix as an experimental benchmark.
